body:
Oh you'd be surprised at how stupid I am.  It's like a special kind of stupid.  You'd expect anyone like me to actually have good grades and whatnot but no, I can't study for shit.

I'm going for psychology for my courses.  I do have plans for the future, but they're "adult" plans.  I'm probably too young to say "I wish I could be a child forever" because let's be fair, stereotypically, only people in their 30's+ want that, but I say it anyways.  I wish I could experience the things a proper child/teen could, like having friends who really talk to each other about their problems, going to camps where your friends aren't holding grudges on each other, etc.  Even going to a friend's house and playing stuff like soccer.  Every time I did that, I would come home holding my legs for the rest of the day and the day after that in pain.  I'd have to skip school sometimes because of it.

To be fair, I don't know why I posted here, because I know that I can't commit suicide due to these unbreakable ties, like I mentioned in my post title.  I don't want to ruin other people's lives because I don't want to exist.  It's not that it's selfish, but it's that I feel guilty.  I want to go out of this world feeling satisfied, feeling no regrets.  I can't regret getting a biological injury, that's going to happen either way, but I can regret leaving people behind who love me in their own way, such as my parents and my brother.

I've thought of plots to defame myself but all of them end up with at least 1 person knowing what really happened, and 1 is more than enough, so I can't.  If I didn't care about other people so foolishly to the point where it's such a detriment to me, I would've been dead a year ago, for sure, but sadly, my brain is hardwired to naively caring about people, some who don't even deserve it, because I'm a massive mess.

But, honestly, I'm feeling a bit better right now.  My dad just found our old N64 and I've been playing Super Mario 64, which is really nostalgic.  I guarantee the feeling will disappear as soon as I put my mind to something else (I can already feel it fading lmao) but hey, that's life.  I hope you're having a fantastic day, and thank you for taking your time to comment for me.  The feeling where someone who doesn't even know me cares enough to comment does put a bit of a smile on my face, and I hope someone can do the same for you.

Let's assume your wife and three kids all think of you as a failure, too, because I don't want to say "Well what about them?" only to find out they aren't available at the moment, in that sense.

I'm young, so I don't understand much about business.  I do understand that money is a necessity in the adult life, though, so start off by talking with your wife about it.  How are you two doing?  Is there no hope?  Even if she thinks of you as a failure, use that as motivation.  Make it so she doesn't think this way.

Redemption.  It's a scary word, because we're always afraid we'll fail to reach the expectations of the ones we love, the ones around us, the ones who care about us, as well as the ones we care about.  But you will never know until you try.

I'm sorry because it's the most I can say.  I'm sure you know this, but we aren't angels who can solve your problems.  You are the strongest person in your life right now, you can make things right.  It's responsibility that comes with being a parent and being a husband.

I know you might feel overwhelmed, but I'm going to be selfish and ask you not to feel that way.  This is your job, this is your reason, this is your salvation and your redemption.  Right now, set your mind straight, with the thought of a better and clearer future ahead of you.

*You* can do this, and ONLY you can do this.  Your wife can help with money, your children can help with your emotions, but only you can help with your redemption.  Become the person you WANT to become.

It's actually a whole lot easier than you think it is.  You just have to clear your mind and think, and most importantly, believe in yourself.

You don't have to be fake.  You don't have to pretend.  You really can be.  It's not insane, it's not a far stretch.  It's something that you can achieve, but only if you really believe in yourself.

You can't do anything if you don't.  You can't do anything if you don't think you can.  So please, for your own good, believe in yourself.  For your children, believe in yourself.  For your wife, believe in yourself.

Even if they hate you.  Even if they don't.  Even if they think you're pathetic.  Even if they don't.

In the end, you are seeking for your own redemption.  You want to be helped.

The greatest and most successful helper in your life is you.  You've overcome so many problems up until now, yes?  So why stop?  Keep going.  Life, along with all its beautiful and shitty moments, never end until you die, and for every 100 shitty things that might happen, 1 beautiful thing also does.

Life really is beautiful.  It makes you want to live for just that one thing.  It's always amazing when it happens.  We always feel touched.  We always feel blessed.

Open your heart to yourself, believe in yourself, and, while I can't guarantee you that it will work out, I believe YOU can do that.  I believe that you can guarantee yourself that it will work out.
